description: Driving simulator dataset on human driven vehicles' speed compliance under variable speed limits in mixed traffic with automated vehicles provides speed-compliance observations from a fixed-base SCANeR driving simulator with variable speed limits and mixed automation. The provider is Research creators via 4TU.ResearchData. Geographical and temporal coverage: The TU Delft experiment used 36 participants and seven scenarios; data collection was in 2020. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Simulator behaviour and the participant sample do not establish population-wide responses on real roads. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
